description: This file defines the class 'InstructionFileMetadataStrategy' which implements metadata storage and retrieval strategies using AWS S3 for encryption metadata envelopes. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically handling instruction files associated with client-side encryption.

classes.name: InstructionFileMetadataStrategy
classes.description: Implements a strategy to store and retrieve encryption instruction files and associated metadata on Amazon S3.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with an S3 client and optional suffix for instruction files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Uploads the encryption metadata envelope as an instruction file to S3.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Retrieves and reconstructs the encryption metadata envelope from an instruction file on S3.
